ios.desc:
Split expenses with friends, roommates and family. No account, no ads and no subscription.

One person creates a group. Everyone else joins with a six-character code or scans its QR code. Add who paid, how much and who shared each expense.

SPLIT EACH EXPENSE YOUR WAY
• Equally, when everyone shared it evenly.
• By shares, for splits such as 2:1 or 3:1.
• By exact amounts, when each person owes something different.

Use a different split for each expense, whether you are sharing rent, groceries, dinner or a vacation.

SEE WHO PAYS WHOM
Check each person's balance and use the settle-up view for a clear repayment plan. Record a payment after it has been made. Splitright does not move money: pay each other by bank transfer, cash or your usual payment app.

43 SUPPORTED CURRENCIES
Add expenses in 43 currencies. Convert mixed-currency expenses at settle-up, using saved exchange rates where available. The app shows the rates used; older expenses without saved rates can use current rates.

KEEP YOUR GROUP ORGANIZED
• Keep separate groups for home, trips and other shared costs.
• Search expenses by description or filter by who paid.
• Archive a group when you no longer need it in your active list.
• Use Splitright on iPhone and iPad.

NO SIGN-UP — SHARE THE CODE WITH CARE
There are no accounts to create. Shared group details are stored online, and anyone with the group's code can access that group. Only share it with people you trust.

Questions? Visit getsplitright.com.
